title: What makes a good life? Lessons from the longest study on happiness
speaker: Robert Waldinger

sentences.en: What keeps us healthy and happy as we go through life?
sentences.zh: 你会把时间和精力投资在哪里呢？最近在千禧一代中有这么一个调查

sentences.en: If you were going to invest now in your future best self, where would you put your time and your energy?
sentences.zh: 问他们生活中最重要的目标是什么超过80%的人说最大的生活目标就是要有钱

sentences.en: There was a recent survey of millennials asking them what their most important life goals were, and over 80 percent said that a major life goal for them was to get rich.
sentences.zh:
最大的生活目标就是要有钱还有50%的年轻人说另一个重要的生活目标就是要出名（笑声）而且我们总是被灌输
要投入工作，要加倍努力

sentences.en: And another 50 percent of those same young adults said that another major life goal was to become famous.
sentences.zh:
而且我们总是被灌输
要投入工作，要加倍努力要成就更多。我们被灌输了这样一种观念，
只有做到刚才说的这些

sentences.en: (Laughter) And we're constantly told to lean in to work, to push harder and achieve more.
sentences.zh:
我们被灌输了这样一种观念，
只有做到刚才说的这些才能有好日子过。要人们纵观整个人生，想象各种选择，
以及这些选择最终导致的结果，

sentences.en: We're given the impression that these are the things that we need to go after in order to have a good life.
sentences.zh:
想象各种选择，
以及这些选择最终导致的结果，几乎是不可能的。关于人的一生，我们能了解到的，

sentences.en: Pictures of entire lives, of the choices that people make and how those choices work out for them, those pictures are almost impossible to get.
sentences.zh: 关于人的一生，我们能了解到的，大部分都是通过人的回忆得来，但众所周知，大部分都是事后诸葛。

sentences.en: Most of what we know about human life we know from asking people to remember the past, and as we know, hindsight is anything but 20/20.
sentences.zh: 一生中，我们会忘记很多发生过的事情，而且记忆常常不可靠。但如果我们可以从头到尾地纵观人的一生呢？

sentences.en: We forget vast amounts of what happens to us in life, and sometimes memory is downright creative.
sentences.zh:
纵观人的一生呢？如果我们可以跟踪研究一个人，
从他少年时代开始

sentences.en: But what if we could watch entire lives as they unfold through time?
sentences.zh:
一直到他步入晚年，看看究竟是什么让人们
保持快乐和健康呢？我们做到了。

sentences.en: What if we could study people from the time that they were teenagers all the way into old age to see what really keeps people happy and healthy?
sentences.zh:
我们做到了。哈佛大学（进行的）这项
关于成人发展的研究，可能是同类研究中耗时最长的。在75年时间里，
我们跟踪了724个人的一生，

sentences.en: We did that. The Harvard Study of Adult Development may be the longest study of adult life that's ever been done.
sentences.zh:
在75年时间里，
我们跟踪了724个人的一生，年复一年，了解他们的工作、
家庭生活、健康状况，

sentences.en: For 75 years, we've tracked the lives of 724 men, year after year, asking about their work, their home lives, their health,
sentences.zh:
年复一年，了解他们的工作、
家庭生活、健康状况，当然，在这一过程中，
我们完全不知道他们的人生将走向何方。像这样的研究少之又少。像这样的项目几乎都会在10年内终止，

sentences.en: and of course asking all along the way without knowing how their life stories were going to turn out.
sentences.zh: 像这样的项目几乎都会在10年内终止，因为有许多人会中途退出，

sentences.en: Studies like this are exceedingly rare. Almost all projects of this kind fall apart within a decade because too many people drop out of the study, or funding for the research dries up,
sentences.zh: 或者是研究资金不足，或者是研究者转换方向，或者去世，然后项目无人接手。但感谢幸运女神的眷顾和几代研究人员的坚持不懈，

sentences.en: or the researchers get distracted, or they die, and nobody moves the ball further down the field.
sentences.zh: 和几代研究人员的坚持不懈，这个项目存活下来了。目前这724人中

sentences.en: But through a combination of luck and the persistence of several generations of researchers, this study has survived.
sentences.zh: 目前这724人中仍有60人在世，仍然在参与研究大多数人已经90多岁了。现在我们已经开始研究

sentences.en: About 60 of our original 724 men are still alive, still participating in the study, most of them in their 90s.
sentences.zh:
现在我们已经开始研究他们的子孙后代，
人数多达2000多人。我是这个项目的第四任负责人。从1938年起，我们
开始跟踪两组人的生活。

sentences.en: And we are now beginning to study the more than 2,000 children of these men.
sentences.zh:
从1938年起，我们
开始跟踪两组人的生活。第一组加入这个项目的人，当年在哈佛大学上大二。

sentences.en: And I'm the fourth director of the study.
sentences.zh: 当年在哈佛大学上大二。他们在二战期间大学毕业，

sentences.en: Since 1938, we've tracked the lives of two groups of men.
sentences.zh: 他们在二战期间大学毕业，大部分人都参军作战了。我们追踪的第二组人

sentences.en: The first group started in the study when they were sophomores at Harvard College.
sentences.zh: 我们追踪的第二组人是一群来自波士顿贫民区的小男孩，

sentences.en: They all finished college during World War II, and then most went off to serve in the war.
sentences.zh:
是一群来自波士顿贫民区的小男孩，他们之所以被选中，主要是因为他们来自
20世纪30年代波士顿

sentences.en: And the second group that we've followed was a group of boys from Boston's poorest neighborhoods, boys who were chosen for the study specifically because they were from some of the most troubled and disadvantaged families
sentences.zh:
最困难最贫困的家庭。大部分住在廉价公寓里，
很多都没有冷热水供应。在加入这个项目时，这些年轻人都接受了面试。

sentences.en: in the Boston of the 1930s. Most lived in tenements, many without hot and cold running water.
sentences.zh: 这些年轻人都接受了面试。接受了身体检查。我们挨家挨户走访了他们的父母。

sentences.en: When they entered the study, all of these teenagers were interviewed.
sentences.zh: 然后这些年轻人长大成人，进入到社会各个阶层。成为了工人、律师、砖匠、医生，

sentences.en: They were given medical exams. We went to their homes and we interviewed their parents.
sentences.zh: 成为了工人、律师、砖匠、医生，还有一位成了美国总统。

sentences.en: And then these teenagers grew up into adults who entered all walks of life.
sentences.zh: 还有一位成了美国总统。有人成为酒鬼，有人患了精神分裂。

sentences.en: They became factory workers and lawyers and bricklayers and doctors, one President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 有人成为酒鬼，有人患了精神分裂。有人从社会最底层一路青云直上，

sentences.en: Some developed alcoholism. A few developed schizophrenia.
sentences.zh: 也有人恰相反，掉落云端。这个项目的创始人们，

sentences.en: Some climbed the social ladder from the bottom all the way to the very top, and some made that journey in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 这个项目的创始人们，可能做梦都不会想到75年后的今天，我会站在这里，告诉你们这个项目还在继续。

sentences.en: The founders of this study would never in their wildest dreams have imagined that I would be standing here today, 75 years later, telling you that the study still continues.
sentences.zh:
告诉你们这个项目还在继续。每两年，我们耐心而专注的研究人员会打电话给我们的研究对象，
问他们是否愿意再做一套关于他们生活的问卷。那些来自波士顿的人问我们，

sentences.en: Every two years, our patient and dedicated research staff calls up our men and asks them if we can send them yet one more set of questions about their lives.
sentences.zh:
那些来自波士顿的人问我们，“为什么你们一直想研究我？
我的生活是很无趣的。”但哈佛的人从没这样问过。

sentences.en: Many of the inner city Boston men ask us, "Why do you keep wanting to study me? My life just isn't that interesting."
sentences.zh: （笑声）

sentences.en: The Harvard men never ask that question.
sentences.zh: （笑声）为了更好地了解这些人的生活，

sentences.en: (Laughter) To get the clearest picture of these lives,
sentences.zh: 为了更好地了解这些人的生活，我们不光给他们发问卷。我们还在他们家客厅采访他们。从他们医生那儿拿病历。抽他们的血，扫描他们的大脑，跟他们的孩子聊天。

sentences.en: we don't just send them questionnaires. We interview them in their living rooms.
sentences.zh:
跟他们的孩子聊天。我们拍摄下他们和妻子谈话的场景，
聊的都是他们最关心的问题。

sentences.en: We get their medical records from their doctors.
sentences.zh:
我们拍摄下他们和妻子谈话的场景，
聊的都是他们最关心的问题。大约在10年前，我们
终于开口问他们的妻子，

sentences.en: We draw their blood, we scan their brains, we talk to their children.
sentences.zh:
大约在10年前，我们
终于开口问他们的妻子，是否愿意加入我们的研究，很多女士都说，“是啊，
终于轮到我们了。”

sentences.en: We videotape them talking with their wives about their deepest concerns.
sentences.zh:
很多女士都说，“是啊，
终于轮到我们了。”（笑声）那么我们得到了什么结论呢？那长达几万页的数据记录，
记录了他们的生活，

sentences.en: And when, about a decade ago, we finally asked the wives if they would join us as members of the study, many of the women said, "You know, it's about time."
sentences.zh:
那长达几万页的数据记录，
记录了他们的生活，我们从这些记录中间，到底学到了什么？

sentences.en: (Laughter) So what have we learned? What are the lessons that come from the tens of thousands of pages of information that we've generated on these lives?
sentences.zh:
到底学到了什么？不是关于财富、名望，
或更加努力工作。从75年的研究中，
我们得到的最明确的结论是：

sentences.en: Well, the lessons aren't about wealth or fame or working harder and harder.
sentences.zh:
从75年的研究中，
我们得到的最明确的结论是：良好的人际关系能
让人更加快乐和健康。就这样。

sentences.en: The clearest message that we get from this 75-year study is this: Good relationships keep us happier and healthier. Period.
sentences.zh:
良好的人际关系能
让人更加快乐和健康。就这样。关于人际关系，我们得到三大结论。第一，社会关系对我们是有益的，而孤独寂寞有害健康。我们发现，那些跟家庭成员更亲近的人，

sentences.en: We've learned three big lessons about relationships.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，那些跟家庭成员更亲近的人，更爱与朋友、与邻居交往的人，

sentences.en: The first is that social connections are really good for us, and that loneliness kills.
sentences.zh: 更爱与朋友、与邻居交往的人，会比那些不善交际、离群索居的人，更快乐，更健康，更长寿。

sentences.en: It turns out that people who are more socially connected to family, to friends, to community, are happier, they're physically healthier, and they live longer than people who are less well connected.
sentences.zh:
更快乐，更健康，更长寿。孤独寂寞是有害健康的。那些“被孤立”的人，
跟不孤单的人相比，往往更加不快乐，等他们人到中年时，健康状况下降更快，

sentences.en: And the experience of loneliness turns out to be toxic.
sentences.zh: 等他们人到中年时，健康状况下降更快，大脑功能下降得更快，

sentences.en: People who are more isolated than they want to be from others find that they are less happy, their health declines earlier in midlife, their brain functioning declines sooner
sentences.zh:
大脑功能下降得更快，也没那么长寿。可惜的是，长久以来，每5个美国人中就至少
有1个声称自己是孤独的。

sentences.en: and they live shorter lives than people who are not lonely.
sentences.zh:
每5个美国人中就至少
有1个声称自己是孤独的。而且即便你身在人群中，
甚至已经结婚了，

sentences.en: And the sad fact is that at any given time, more than one in five Americans will report that they're lonely.
sentences.zh: 你还是可能感到孤独，因此我们得到的第二大结论是不是你有多少朋友，也不是你身边有没有伴侣，

sentences.en: And we know that you can be lonely in a crowd and you can be lonely in a marriage, so the second big lesson that we learned is that it's not just the number of friends you have, and it's not whether or not you're in a committed relationship,
sentences.zh: 也不是你身边有没有伴侣，真正有影响的是这些关系的质量。整天吵吵闹闹，对健康是有害的。比如成天吵架，没有爱的婚姻，

sentences.en: but it's the quality of your close relationships that matters.
sentences.zh: 比如成天吵架，没有爱的婚姻，对健康的影响或许比离婚还大。

sentences.en: It turns out that living in the midst of conflict is really bad for our health.
sentences.zh:
对健康的影响或许比离婚还大。而关系和睦融洽，
则对我们的健康有益。

sentences.en: High-conflict marriages, for example, without much affection, turn out to be very bad for our health, perhaps worse than getting divorced.
sentences.zh:
而关系和睦融洽，
则对我们的健康有益。当我们的研究对象步入80岁时，我们会回顾他们的中年生活看我们能否预测

sentences.en: And living in the midst of good, warm relationships is protective.
sentences.zh: 看我们能否预测哪些人会在八九十岁时过得快乐健康哪些人不会。

sentences.en: Once we had followed our men all the way into their 80s, we wanted to look back at them at midlife and to see if we could predict who was going to grow into a happy, healthy octogenarian and who wasn't.
sentences.zh: 哪些人不会。我们把他们50岁时的所有信息进行汇总分析，发现决定他们将如何老去的，并不是他们中年时的胆固醇水平。

sentences.en: And when we gathered together everything we knew about them at age 50, it wasn't their middle age cholesterol levels that predicted how they were going to grow old.
sentences.zh: 而是他们对婚姻生活的满意度。那些在50岁时满意度最高的人，在80岁时也是最健康的。

sentences.en: It was how satisfied they were in their relationships.
sentences.zh: 在80岁时也是最健康的。另外，良好和亲密的婚姻关系能减缓衰老带来的痛苦。

sentences.en: The people who were the most satisfied in their relationships at age 50 were the healthiest at age 80.
sentences.zh: 能减缓衰老带来的痛苦。参与者中那些最幸福的夫妻告诉我们，

sentences.en: And good, close relationships seem to buffer us from some of the slings and arrows of getting old.
sentences.zh: 在他们80多岁时，哪怕身体出现各种毛病，他们依旧觉得日子很幸福。

sentences.en: Our most happily partnered men and women reported, in their 80s, that on the days when they had more physical pain, their mood stayed just as happy.
sentences.zh:
而那些婚姻不快乐的人，身体上会出现更多不适，因为坏情绪把身体的痛苦放大了。关于婚姻和健康的关系，
我们得到的第三大结论是，

sentences.en: But the people who were in unhappy relationships, on the days when they reported more physical pain, it was magnified by more emotional pain.
sentences.zh:
关于婚姻和健康的关系，
我们得到的第三大结论是，幸福的婚姻不单能保护我们的身体，还能保护我们的大脑。研究发现，如果在80多岁时，

sentences.en: And the third big lesson that we learned about relationships and our health is that good relationships don't just protect our bodies, they protect our brains.
sentences.zh:
研究发现，如果在80多岁时，你的婚姻生活还温暖和睦，你对自己的另一半依然信任有加，
知道对方在关键时刻能指望得上，

sentences.en: It turns out that being in a securely attached relationship to another person in your 80s is protective, that the people who are in relationships where they really feel they can count on the other person in times of need,
sentences.zh:
依然信任有加，
知道对方在关键时刻能指望得上，那么你的记忆力都不容易衰退。而反过来，那些觉得无法信任
自己的另一半的人，记忆力会更早表现出衰退。

sentences.en: those people's memories stay sharper longer.
sentences.zh: 记忆力会更早表现出衰退。幸福的婚姻，并不意味着从不拌嘴。

sentences.en: And the people in relationships where they feel they really can't count on the other one, those are the people who experience earlier memory decline.
sentences.zh: 幸福的婚姻，并不意味着从不拌嘴。有些夫妻，八九十岁了，还天天斗嘴，但只要他们坚信，在关键时刻，

sentences.en: And those good relationships, they don't have to be smooth all the time.
sentences.zh: 但只要他们坚信，在关键时刻，对方能靠得住，那这些争吵顶多只是生活的调味剂。

sentences.en: Some of our octogenarian couples could bicker with each other day in and day out, but as long as they felt that they could really count on the other when the going got tough, those arguments didn't take a toll on their memories.
sentences.zh: 那这些争吵顶多只是生活的调味剂。所以请记住，幸福和睦的婚姻对健康是有利的，这是永恒的真理。

sentences.en: So this message, that good, close relationships are good for our health and well-being, this is wisdom that's as old as the hills.
sentences.zh: 但为什么我们总是办不到呢？因为我们是人类。我们总喜欢找捷径，总想一劳永逸，找到一种方法，解决所有问题。

sentences.en: Why is this so hard to get and so easy to ignore?
sentences.zh: 找到一种方法，解决所有问题。人际关系麻烦又复杂，

sentences.en: Well, we're human. What we'd really like is a quick fix, something we can get that'll make our lives good and keep them that way.
sentences.zh: 人际关系麻烦又复杂，与家人、朋友相处需要努力付出，一点也不高大上。而且需要一辈子投入，无穷无尽。

sentences.en: Relationships are messy and they're complicated and the hard work of tending to family and friends, it's not sexy or glamorous.
sentences.zh:
而且需要一辈子投入，无穷无尽。在我们长达75年的研究中，
那些最享受退休生活的人，是那些主动用玩伴
来替代工作伙伴的人。

sentences.en: It's also lifelong. It never ends. The people in our 75-year study who were the happiest in retirement were the people who had actively worked to replace workmates with new playmates.
sentences.zh:
是那些主动用玩伴
来替代工作伙伴的人。就像开头我说过的千禧一代一样，我们跟踪研究的很多人
在年轻的时候坚信名望、财富和成就是他们过上好日子的保证。

sentences.en: Just like the millennials in that recent survey, many of our men when they were starting out as young adults really believed that fame and wealth and high achievement were what they needed to go after to have a good life.
sentences.zh:
是他们过上好日子的保证。但在75年的时间里，
我们的研究一次次地证明，日子过得最好的，
是那些主动与人交往的人，与家人、朋友或者邻居。

sentences.en: But over and over, over these 75 years, our study has shown that the people who fared the best were the people who leaned in to relationships, with family, with friends, with community.
sentences.zh:
与家人、朋友或者邻居。那么你们呢？也许你现在25岁，
或者40岁，或者60岁。怎样才算主动与人交往呢？

sentences.en: So what about you? Let's say you're 25, or you're 40, or you're 60.
sentences.zh:
嗯，我想有很多种方法吧。最简单的，别再跟屏幕聊天了，
去跟人聊天，

sentences.en: What might leaning in to relationships even look like?
sentences.zh:
最简单的，别再跟屏幕聊天了，
去跟人聊天，或者一起尝试些新事物，
让关系恢复活力，

sentences.en: Well, the possibilities are practically endless.
sentences.zh:
或者一起尝试些新事物，
让关系恢复活力，一起散个步呀，晚上约个会呀，

sentences.en: It might be something as simple as replacing screen time with people time or livening up a stale relationship by doing something new together, long walks or date nights,
sentences.zh:
一起散个步呀，晚上约个会呀，或者给多年未曾联系的亲戚打个电话，因为这种家庭不和睦太常见了，但它带来的伤害又很大，尤其对那些喜欢
生闷气的人来说更是如此。

sentences.en: or reaching out to that family member who you haven't spoken to in years, because those all-too-common family feuds take a terrible toll on the people who hold the grudges.
sentences.zh:
尤其对那些喜欢
生闷气的人来说更是如此。我想引用马克•吐温的一段话来作为结束。一个多世纪前，他回首自己的人生，

sentences.en: I'd like to close with a quote from Mark Twain.
sentences.zh: 写下这样一段话：“时光荏苒，生命短暂，

sentences.en: More than a century ago, he was looking back on his life, and he wrote this: "There isn't time, so brief is life, for bickerings, apologies, heartburnings, callings to account.
sentences.zh:
别将时间浪费在
